title: Notice an operator question outcome
when: A worker question is answered, withdrawn or consumed
need: The shared hook and watcher digest prints the saved outcome once. Question status changes wake steering on the next watcher poll and request a report before its scheduled interval. Failed answer delivery stays visible for manual relay. Questions follow steering seat coverage: the seat covering the question's item, the asker's claimed item, or its project sees it; each seat sees its own questions; other hand-started sessions' questions never show; work with no live seat shows to the owning project seat as unattended. The Inbox and decision-requests list still show every question.
review: Source regression coverage; post-release Inbox answer and steering wake proof is still owed.
